traits.d: The rat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.d: Melee Weapon Attack: +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

traits.d: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the bugbear hits with it (included in the attack).
The bugbear has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, stunned, or put to sleep.
If the bugbear surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage from the attack.

actions.d: The bugbear makes two melee attacks.
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage.
Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage in melee or 5 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage at range.
Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

traits.d: The mimic can use its action to polymorph into an object or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.
The mimic has advantage on attack rolls against any creature grappled by it.
The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mimic is also grappled by it (escape DC 13). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage.
While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object.

actions.d: The mimic can make three attacks; two with its pseudopods and one with its bite
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the mimic is in object form, the target is subjected to its Adhesive trait.
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) acid damage.

traits.d: The drow has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put the drow to sleep.

Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature or attacking at long range doesn't impose disadvantage on the drow's ranged attack rolls with a pistol. In addition, the drow ignores half cover and three-quarters cover when making ranged attacks with a pistol.
The drow's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12) It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: dancing lights
1/day each: darkness, faerie fire, levitate (self only)
While in sunlight, the drow has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.d: The drow makes two shortsword attacks.
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.
Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) poison damage.

traits.d: The engineer has advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.
The engineer is a 1st-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following wizard spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, mending, prestidigitation
1st level (2 slots): burning hands, disguise self, shield

actions.d: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

traits.d: The falcon has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.d: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage.

stat.cimm: blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.d: The staff is incapacitated while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, the staff must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.
While the staff remains motionless and isn't flying, it is indistinguishable from a normal staff.

actions.d: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

elements.name: Griffon Cavalry Rider
elements.desc: Medium humanoid (any race), any alignment. Challenge 2.

actions.d: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit (with disadvantage against a target within 5 ft.), reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d12 + 2) piercing damage, or 11 (1d12 + 5) piercing damage while mounted.
Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. Or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
The rider wears a magic ring with which it can cast the feather fall spell on itself once as a reaction to falling. After the spell is cast, the ring becomes nonmagical.
Melee Weapon Attack: +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d3) piercing damage, and the bird is destroyed by the impact.

stat.res: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
stat.langs: Understands one language known to its creator but can't speak

traits.d: The nimblewright has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
The nimblewright's weapon attacks are magical.
As long as it has at least 1 hit point remaining, the nimblewright regains 1 hit point when a mending spell is cast on it.
The nimblewright has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it prone.

actions.d: The nimblewright makes three attacks: two with its rapier and one with its dagger.
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage. Or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

reactions.d: The nimblewright adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the nimblewright must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

traits.d: The dwarf has advantage on saving throws against poison and resistance to poison damage.
The Dwarf is a 1st-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence. It has the following wizard spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, mending, prestidigitation
1st level (2 slots): burning hands, disguise self, shield

actions.d: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage. Or Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

elements.name: Sergeant
elements.desc: Medium humanoid (any race), any alignment. Challenge 1/8.

actions.d: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

elements.name: Shard Shunner
elements.desc: Small humanoid (halfling, shapechanger), lawful evil. Challenge 2.

stat.imm: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

traits.d: The Shard Shunner can use their action to polymorph into a rat-humanoid hybrid or into a giant rat, or back into their true form, which is humanoid. Their statistics, other than their size, are the same in each form. Any equipment they are wearing or carrying isn't transformed. They revert to their true form if they die.
The Shard Shunner has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.
The Shard Shunner can move through the space of creatures that is of a size larger than them.
The Shard Shunner has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.d: The Shard Shunner makes two attacks, only one of which can be a bite.

Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with wererat lycanthropy.
Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.n: Hand Crossbow (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.d: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

elements.name: Swarm of Books
elements.desc: Medium swarm of tiny constructs, unaligned. Challenge 1/4.

stat.cimm: charmed, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned, grappled

traits.d: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny book. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

actions.d: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. Hit: 5 (2d4) bludgeoning damage, or 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

elements.name: Swarm of Mechanical Spiders
elements.desc: Medium swarm of tiny constructs, unaligned. Challenge 1/2.

stat.cimm: exhaustion, charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned, poisoned

traits.d: The swarm doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.
The swarm can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.
While in contact with a web, the swarm knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.
The swarm ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.d: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 10 (4d4) piercing damage, or 5 (2d4) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

stat.imm: cold, fire, poison, psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with adamantine weapons
stat.cimm: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, stunned

traits.d: When the statue drops to 0 hit points, it crumbles and is destroyed. Any creature on the ground within 30 feet of the crumbling statue must make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
The statue is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.
The statue has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
The statue deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.d: The statue makes two melee attacks.
Melee Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (3d12 + 10) bludgeoning damage.
Ranged Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, range 200/800 ft., one target. Hit: 43 (6d10 + 10) bludgeoning damage.

traits.d: The adept wears a teleporter ring.
The adept has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.
The adept can move through a space of a Medium or larger creature.
While the adept is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

actions.d: The adept makes three unarmed strikes or three dart attacks.
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, the adept can choose one of the following additional effects:

actions.n: The target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or drop one item it is holding (adept's choice)
actions.d:
The target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the adept's next turn.
Dart. Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

reactions.d: In response to being hit by a ranged weapon attack, the adept deflects the missile. The damage it takes from the attack is reduced by 1d10 + 3. If the damage is reduced to 0, the adept catches the missile if it's small enough to hold in one hand and the adept has a hand free.
